theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_lc_measure_le_of_le_on_open
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (μ ν : Measure (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → μ Uᶜ = 0 → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ν K < ∞) → (∀ V : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen V → V ⊆ U → μ V ≤ ν V) → μ ≤ ν
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
